page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc8i.6xlarge is a compute-focused instance within the High Clock Speed family, operating on the KVM hypervisor. The virtual machine provides 24 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6462C processor based on the x86_64 architecture, operating at a 3.3 GHz clock speed. System memory is provisioned at 48.0 GB, establishing a 1:2 core-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU.

The instance includes no bundled local storage, requiring attached cloud disk volumes for the operating system and persistent data. High-throughput network communication is supported by an 18 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance is not equipped with discrete graphics processing units and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its high clock speed cores and dedicated compute resources, the ecs.hfc8i.6xlarge offers resource density tailored for computational efficiency rather than large in-memory storage. The instance is suited for compute-heavy workloads such as software compilation, continuous integration and deployment pipelines, video transcoding, multi-tenant application servers, and gaming backend hosting.
